nodes.label: Config Registry (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: src/lib/config/registry.ts is TypeScript (not JSON) for full type-checking; a structured metadata layer COMPARED against the prose tables and .env.example via three-way parity (config:docs:check), not a replacement. Marking an entry deprecated never changes config:validate pass/fail behavior — removalVersion 1.0.0 marks when enforcement/variable is actually removed. sensitivity field is descriptive metadata, not a redaction mechanism.

nodes.label: Four-role database separation (migration 045)
nodes.rationale: Migration owner, awcms_micro_app, awcms_micro_worker, awcms_micro_setup — each granted only rights its code path actually uses. WORKER/SETUP_DATABASE_URL optional (fall back to DATABASE_URL) so small/offline deployments still run under one narrowed app role. Defense-in-depth over the singleton setup lock and RLS FORCE, not a replacement. checkRuntimeRoleGlobalTableGrants is the regression guard against future migrations granting extra access on the 9 global (non-RLS) tables.

nodes.label: Full-online deployment profile (ADR-0027)
nodes.rationale: Canonical deployment/storage model is full-online (FullOnlineDeploymentProfile, storage-profile.ts, ADR-0027). Legacy offline/LAN phrasing persists as shorthand for 'no internet needed for that operation', not a claim of offline-first mode; production must not rely on ephemeral container FS for managed media (checkDurableMediaStorageReady gate).

nodes.label: Deployment-aware connection capacity (Issue #743)
nodes.rationale: capacity-config.ts models cross-instance connection capacity that per-process pools cannot see; database:capacity:check validates sum(instance_count x pool_max) + reserved_headroom <= approved capacity at max configured instances, read-only, defaults safe for single-instance LAN-first without PgBouncer.

nodes.label: Public tenant routing config (Issue #556/#559)
nodes.rationale: PUBLIC_TENANT_RESOLUTION_MODE (host_default/env_default/setup_default/tenant_code_legacy). Unset != tenant_code_legacy at the resolver: unset still runs the env->setup fallback chain, tenant_code_legacy returns null (operator explicitly opts out of default-tenant guessing). host_default requires PUBLIC_PLATFORM_ROOT_DOMAIN; PUBLIC_TRUST_PROXY only true behind a trusted overwrite proxy.

nodes.label: Full-online auth security hardening gate (Issue #587-#593)
nodes.rationale: isFullOnlineSecurityActive(env) requires BOTH AUTH_ONLINE_SECURITY_ENABLED=true AND AUTH_ONLINE_SECURITY_PROFILE=full_online, plus each feature flag (Turnstile/MFA/Google OIDC/SSO). APP_ENV=production is NOT a proxy for this gate; offline/LAN deployments are production-grade without any online-only feature and need no provider credentials.

nodes.label: Request body size limits (Issue #686)
nodes.rationale: No env var — deliberately code constants (request-body-limit.ts) so no deployment can quietly raise the hard ceiling without code review. readJsonBody/readTextBody/readFormBody enforce Content-Length before reading and stream-count bytes (declared length never trusted alone). Not middleware because next(request) triggers Astro pipeline.tryRewrite; middleware checkContentLengthCeiling is a separate cheap backstop only.
